affected_locations: Hess Port Reading Refinery, Port Reading, New Jersey
Bayway Refinery Phillips 66, Linden, New Jersey
key_impacts: Storm surge flooding in New York City exceeded the 100-year floodplain by 53% citywide.
Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
Hess Port Reading Refinery (Port Reading, NJ) and Bayway Refinery Phillips 66 (Linden, NJ) were shut down, reducing regional refining capacity.
Gas stations in New Jersey were unable to operate due to power outages.
Three healthcare facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to the outage.
evidence_snippets: Sandy’s arrival on the evening of October 29… generated a massive surge… flooding exceeded the 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide.
Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.

As of November 6 2012… Hess Port Reading Refinery… and Bayway Refinery Phillips 66… were shut down… Gas stations in NJ could not operate… Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn had to… evacuate all patients.
